items.title: Sister Bernice Phillips Interview, 1960-09-03
items.q: Yes, indeed. Yes, indeed. I know Robert.

ctx.x: Yeah. Everybody was upset. He died down like anything else.
Get paralyzed. Do you remember Robert Taylor, the trumpet play? He was supposed to get paralyzed. Yes, indeed. Yes, indeed. I know Robert. He kicked a woman down. She was supposed to fix him.

Yeah, they say that. They say that child. That's what Punch told me. People used to be bad doing things, but I can't get these children to believe nothing like that. That was true. I was scared of everybody and I still am. That's why I don't mix much. And I tried to get them not to mix either. My girl was in California and I didn't rest until I was going out there. I used to tell her, keep women out of your house and be very careful because women is a deceitful, jealous hearted thing. All of them. I used to work…
